messages:
noah: hey team, first-day question — set up my MBP (M3) and Kandji shows Enrolled but the agent status is "not running" and i keep getting a system prompt: "kandji-agent wants to install a helper tool" that won't accept. sudo fails: "alex is not in the sudoers file" (my user is noah). also my SSH key didn't populate and corp wifi cert won't install. i'm on macOS 15.0 (Sonoma beta). anyone seen this with the beta?

it-sophia: welcome noah! we try to avoid beta OSes for onboarding but we can work around it. can you paste the serial and the exact text of the kandji agent error from Console if possible? also run `sw_vers` and `profiles status -type enrollment` for me.

noah: serial C02NMB3M3M3X. `sw_vers` -> "ProductName: macOS
ProductVersion: 15.0
BuildVersion: 24A345". `profiles status -type enrollment` -> "No enrolled profiles." Console log screenshot uploaded (shows: "launchd: failed to load /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/com.kandji.agent: permission denied").

mdm-ivan: thanks. looks like the helper tool install is blocked by a system policy check in Sonoma betas — our signed helper binary is fine on supported macOS releases but the installer consent flow is different. i'll push a supervised helper override and a temporary admin window so you can accept the prompt and complete the agent install. granting 45 minutes.

enroll-bot: Job queued: push_helper_override -> device=C02NMB3M3M3X (job=71459)

enroll-bot: Job completed: push_helper_override -> success (override_applied)

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_local_admin_71460 -> device=C02NMB3M3M3X
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_local_admin_71460 -> success (user added to /etc/sudoers.d/temp-admins)

noah: i clicked the helper prompt and now Kandji agent shows Running. ssh key still missing though — i pasted my pubkey here: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIMyKeyExample... noah@work-laptop

it-sophia: thanks — i'll push the ssh pubkey via profile and escrow FileVault. what does `fdesetup status` show?

noah: `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off." Kandji reports "FV escrow pending". i did not get a FileVault enable prompt during setup.

mdm-ivan: pushing FileVault enable + escrow profile now. note: Sonoma changed the enable flow and our old autoprompt sometimes doesn't trigger; the profile will force enable and escrow the key but it may require a user password change on first login. i'll notify when done.

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_fv_enable_71461 -> device=C02NMB3M3M3X
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_fv_enable_71461 -> success (FileVault enabled, key escrowed)

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_ssh_key_profile_71462 -> device=C02NMB3M3M3X
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_ssh_key_profile_71462 -> success (authorized_keys updated)

noah: i can ssh to git now, and i can `sudo`. homebrew installed. wi-fi cert installed fine and zscaler connects. thanks! :thumbsup:

it-sophia: leaving the 45-minute temp admin active. we'll file a follow-up to validate Kandji helper install on Sonoma betas and add a note to the new-hire guide: avoid beta OS if possible.

noah: all clear on my side, removed dev packages. please revoke the temp admin when convenient. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

mdm-bot: Temporary admin revoked: noah -> removed from /etc/sudoers.d/temp-admins. closing job 71460.
